summary: Opened the participant-eligibility side of decision formation. Sources show votingMembers() merges full members and witnesses, so hinted read-context heartbeats reach witnesses, and a witness echoes Hint/HintHigh back through handleHeartbeatMessage; Peer.Handle admits witness responses and readIndex.confirm counts any accepted responder toward quorum without checking witness status. Recorded that behavior and registered an unresolved investigation plus gap around whether witness-only confirmation can satisfy a linearizable read contract, noting the counterevidence that handleLeaderReadIndex deliberately rejects witnesses as read requesters. No defect claimed; no execution run.
